title: Effective Intrinsic Ergodicity for renewal-type potentials on S-gap shifts
summary: We establish effective intrinsic ergodicity for renewal-type potentials on one-sided \(S\)-gap shifts. Inducing on the one-symbol cylinder \([1]\) reduces the system to a full shift over the alphabet \(S\), where the induced potential becomes a one-symbol potential and the equilibrium measure is Bernoulli. The associated renewal equation has a unique solution \(P\), and under the condition \(P>φ(0^\infty)\) (automatic when \(S\) is infinite), we show that \(P\) is the topological pressure and that the potential admits a unique equilibrium state \(μ_φ\).
